channel.title: The Baller League Blog by Knuckleball
channel.description: Stories, match reports and features from The Baller League, organised by Knuckleball.

item.title: Group B Matchday 1 recap: eight results, 42 goals and Legacy FFA on top
item.description: Every Group B result and scorer from Matchday 1, the full table and the numbers behind Legacy FFA's perfect start.

item.title: Darshan's eight goals: how Legacy FFA's number 7 took the league lead
item.description: Six against NBFC, two against United 5's. Darshan has eight goals in two matches and a four-goal lead at the top of the charts.

item.title: Passion FC start 2-0: Dilsher's hat-trick seals a 4-3 thriller against Veltrix
item.description: Passion FC have won both Group B matches, beating Crescents 4-1 and Veltrix 4-3 with Dilsher scoring four goals in two games.

item.title: United 5's 4-1 Falcons FC: Yashwanth's double and an own goal
item.description: Yashwanth scored twice, Ankit and Nitesh once each, and Falcons' only goal came from an own goal by Swapnil.

item.title: Crescents FC 3-2 First Touch FC: Sanjay's double settles a five-goal game
item.description: Sanjay scored twice and Manoj once as Crescents beat First Touch 3-2. Muied scored both of First Touch's goals.

item.title: How the Baller League works: format, points and tiebreakers explained
item.description: A plain-English guide to Season 02: the two groups, the points system, goal-difference tiebreaks and how scorers are counted.

item.title: Baller League Matchday 1 recap: results, scorers and Group A standings
item.description: Every supplied result and scorer from Group A's opening round, plus the early standings and top-scorers list.

item.title: WLWG FC 4-2 Walkalone FC: the 2-0 comeback that shook Group A
item.description: Walkalone led 2-0. Daniel scored twice as WLWG replied with four to complete the comeback.

item.title: Bangalore Grafters 10-2 Walkalone: Adnan hits four
item.description: Adnan scored four and Fazil three as Bangalore Grafters produced Group A's biggest scoreline so far.

item.title: Baller League Season 2: matchday archive opens
item.description: The Season 2 matchday archive is live: full match replays, extended highlights, goals and player features from the Knuckleball Originals archive.
